Here in Fairfield:
Exit 44 will become Exit 27
Exit 46 will become Exit 28

There are no reports of impediments at present, and officers remain actively on ground, ensuring smooth traffic management.

#FollowLASTMA

[5:25PM] #Alausa #Ikeja #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic along Mobolaji Johnson Avenue from the old tollgate through the Secretariat intersection, linking Dr. Nurudeen Olowopopo and connecting to Otedola underneath the bridge, remains smooth with no notable delays.

Obafemi Awolowo Way is experiencing good vehicular movement from Barracks through Coca-Cola Junction, Radio, and Allen Junction up to Balogun. However, traffic becomes busy approaching Olowu towards the Ikeja underbridge, primarily due to traffic alternation. The return journey is largely free-flowing, though there is some buildup approaching Allen Junction and Radio Junction.

Aromire Road, which links to Adeniyi Jones, Akora Villa, and Hacco, is generally clear. However, the return leg is slightly busy approaching Allen Junction.

Lateef Jakande Road from Coca-Cola Junction through Agidingbi, First Gate, Wemco Junction to Omole Roundabout is moving steadily. The return journey on this route is also smooth.

No obstructions have been observed, and our officers are on ground ensuring effective flow.

#FollowLASTMA

LA MESA DAM UPDATE: MIGHT SPILL

As of 12:10 AM, La Mesa Dam water level rises to 79.88 meters, just 0.27 meters below its spilling point of 80.15. Overflow may hit low-lying areas along the Tullahan River, including parts of Quezon City, Valenzuela, and Malabon. 

Residents near riverbanks are urged to stay alert for possible flooding. | Photo courtesy of Metro Manila PIA 

#dailytribune25 #lamesadam

ADVISORY

Kasunod ng pagtaas ng tubig sa La Mesa Dam sa critical level, nagsimula na ang preemptive evacuation sa mga barangay malapit sa dam at sa mga posibleng daanan ng tubig ng Tullahan River.

Nagpadala na ng mga emergency rescue teams ang Quezon City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (QCDRRMO), Department of Public Order and Safety (DPOS), Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD), Task Force Disiplina, Quezon City Police District (QCPD), District Action Offices, Philippine Red Cross at mga barangay sa mga apektadong lugar upang tumulong sa paglilikas at pagtiyak ng kaligtasan ng mga residente.

Hinihikayat ang mga residente ng Barangay Commonwealth, Nagkaisang Nayon, Sta. Monica, Novaliches Proper, Gulod, Capri, San Bartolome, Sta. Lucia, Bagbag, North Fairview, at Fairview na makipagtulungan at agad na lumikas para sa kanilang kaligtasan.

Evacuation Update as of July 20, 2025 | 12:30 AM

Bilang pag-iingat sa pagbaha na sanhi ng mga pag-ulan dulot ng Habagat at Bagyong #CrisingPH, mayroong itinalagang evacuation sites sa mga piling lugar na bahain o may banta ng landslide para sa ligtas at mabilis na paglikas.

Sa kasalukuyan, nasa 556 pamilya o 1,938 indibidwal na ang inilikas at namamalagi sa evacuation sites sa ating lungsod.

Para sa emergency, tumawag sa HELPLINE 122.
